source.title: A Token of Gratitude
source.objective:
CompletionIt might have been a silly thing to do, but Thule, Gunthar and I were like family... brothers. We never expected our world to be torn apart, nor for Thule to side with the Lich King leaving Gunthar and myself to fight for our humanity...

I can sense the taint of the scourge seeping into Thule's portion of the wand. It will forever be marred, corrupted by his betrayal, but alas I am not ready to let go... maybe with time.

Please accept this token of knowledge as my final thanks.
